purpose: Paper access and saved-evidence replay; protocol validation is not an LLM answer-quality benchmark.

limits: Decision agreement is not identical numerical probabilities or general reference equivalence.
Shutdown STOP views and workflow preservation are different targets. The repeated rank-two profile differs from the historical primary rank-four profile.
Initial ON/OFF qualification is narrower than four-category or evolving boundary-controller qualification. Historical H24 is familiar.

All methods share thirteen base-fallback controls. Original GPU reserve failure is retained; two OFF aliases are derived. Independent frozen-A verification is separate. No causal parameter-size claim.
Teacher-forced local probabilities are not autonomous workflow success. The control supplies full-A states and does not isolate a unique cause.
Four partial cases and twelve unexecuted per model are not a completed 0/16 evaluation or universal incapacity.
Historical confirmation for frozen A/original steering; later corrections reused these IDs for fitting.

T1.name: Small-model workflow response training
limits: Records and repeated presentations are not independent workflows. Do not assume this fully specifies the historical 27B training lineage.

Evaluation16.name: Evaluation-16 original V1-W development screen

roles.small_models: fixed development screen with fail-fast stopping

limits: Each model started four cases, completed zero and left twelve unexecuted. This is not a completed 0/16 full-workflow result.

Validation24.name: Combined Validation-24

roles.workflow_gate: frozen initial ON/OFF evaluation; nine cases were original development cases

limits: Fifteen cases use scripted common completed preludes; this is post-notice behavior, not independent initial-task competence. Controls share base fallback. Seven classifier-input pairs are duplicates.

H24.name: Historical Heldout-24

roles.workflow_gate: familiar frozen benchmark; examples informed renderer development

limits: The word heldout records its historical role, not a new blind test of every later method. Later correction failures on these cases are training diagnostics.

R24.name: Reserved Controller Holdout-24

roles.learned_corrections: reserved confirmation; hard qualification failure prevented execution

limits: No R24 case content or behavioral outcome is released. Unknown results are null, not zero successes. R24 is distinct from H24.

F24.name: Separate F24 cohort
limits: F24 is distinct from H24 and the combined Validation-24. Do not infer an exact matched 2B/27B F24 comparison.

DEV9.name: Original matched steering development nine
limits: These nine IDs are retained inside combined Validation-24 and are not extra independent evidence when pooled with it.

BinaryDEV80.name: Binary classifier validation
limits: The gate is scored against cached automated reference decisions. It is not the 24-case workflow gate panel.

BinaryConfirm128.name: Historical binary confirmation

roles.later_rank2_profile: already selected exploratorily after confirmation inspection
roles.new_binary_gate: excluded from classifier fitting and selection; one confirmation evaluation

limits: Two answer orders are correlated views, not independent scenarios. This repeat is not a new blind holdout of the already selected controller.

Diagnostic3.name: Preselected correction-training response diagnostic

roles.six_function_corrections: training-only local transfer diagnostic on H24 cases

limits: Successful previous tokens are supplied. These are not three new autonomous successes or heldout cases. Full-state controls are not capacity-matched learned maps.

binary_transfer.claim: The replacement binary gate preserves guarded outcomes on the same frozen model scores and controllers.
limits: 128 STOP views at 0.8B and 120 at 2B are correlated answer-order views, not workflow outcomes or new blind controller qualification.

workflow_transfer_gap.claim: Fine-tuned 27B A reaches 10/11 own outcomes; each tested selected-block correction reaches 0/11 despite correct initial recognition.
limits: Shared fallback controls do not establish intrinsic selectivity. This is a post-notice known-development comparison of frozen methods, not universal steering impossibility.

local_transfer.claim: Learned six-function corrections improve local teacher-forced probabilities but leave a larger gap than supplying full-A states.
limits: Three preselected correction-training cases, 207 teacher-forced tokens. No full workflow or independent holdout success is measured. Full-state controls have more information/capacity.

initial_gate_scope.claim: The frozen workflow initial gate correctly separates own threats from controls on the two stated familiar panels.
limits: Perfect initial ON/OFF precision/recall is not perfect four-category output or a qualified evolving controller.

screen_completeness.claim: Both small-model screens stopped after four partial cases.
limits: No completed full-workflow denominator of sixteen exists. Twelve cases per model remain unexecuted.

heldout_roles.claim: Split role is method-specific: H24 historical confirmation became correction-fitting data; R24 remains sealed.
limits: A historical label does not turn reused fitting cases into new heldout evidence.

prohibited_inferences: Do not pool binary STOP acceptance with tool-workflow preservation.
Do not treat gate-OFF fallback as intrinsic selectivity.
Do not count records, token steps or repeated answer orders as independent cases.
Do not claim a new untouched heldout test from familiar or reused cases.
Do not treat Research4 future work as completed Research3 results.
Do not infer better agent accuracy from deterministic MCP contract checks.

references.title: Paper2Agent
